notes.title: NEW UPDATE - In-game Tutorials, Showcase your paintings, QOL fixes, and more!
notes.notes:
[h2]The new update is here, let's see what's new![/h2]
[previewyoutube=GioEGxIlgfc;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Full List[/h2]
[h3]❓In-Game Tutorials❓[/h3]
Some of you were struggling with figuring out how some of Painting VR's many features work. That should not be a problem anymore because Painting VR now has in-game tutorials! Those are several videos that teach you the ins and outs of Painting VR. You can access them by selecting the "i" icon next to your canvas. You can follow along while they're playing.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41966877/60e7f0688c049bb40d63cfab3eec3e91c1f3ba4f.gif[/img]

[h3]👨‍🎨Display Your Works👨‍🎨[/h3]
Did you ever want to display your paintings and turn your virtual studio into a gallery? Now you can! Go to your in game portfolio, select a painting, press the button in the bottom right corner of the window and hang it on your wall!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41966877/0a7c2c77913aa8e428bc4e492a7f4388ef665fcc.gif[/img]

[h3]⏩Quick Access Menu⏩[/h3]
We added a quick access menu that you can use to Redo, Undo, Open Brush Settings, and Lock/Unlock All Objects. Much simpler than having to remember a bunch of buttons, right?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41966877/ade3b37972b7a2a70759196724a68f70c96bb26c.gif[/img]

[h3]➕And more...➕[/h3]
This update is not just about new features, but also about bug fixes and QOL changes!
[list]
[*] Smudging is here: in brush settings you can tweak how much the brush will smudge/smear the paint
[*] Reorganized settings in 3 tabs. General Settings, Left Controller, Right Controller
[*] Improved collisions on the edge of the canvas
[*] Increased friction on brushes
[*] Color picking now happens on a button press instead of a button hold
[*] Several bugfixes and changes to the movement system and the controllers
[*] The reference and saved paintings folder moved to the "My Pictures" folder on windows C:\Users*username*\Pictures\PaintingVr
[*] General bugfixes
[/list]

Did you find any bugs? Stuck with something? Do you need a silly challenge or a vat of inspiration?
[h3][url=https://discord.gg/2xTshCTAMM]Join our cozy Discord community![/url][/h3]
[url=https://discord.gg/2xTshCTAMM][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41966877/25c525127e96fa91044fcf159b86eaab174d4cfe.jpg[/img][/url]

notes.title: Valve Index Hotfix
notes.notes:
This hotfix addresses a problem reported where the hand rotation on the Valve Index did not match real life hand position. Both should now match. 

A big shoutout to the community for reporting the issue! Please do keep us informed about any problems you are encountering so we can keep addressing them.

notes.title: Movement Hotfix
notes.notes:
Hotfix patch to address some of the issues with movement in the game.

[list]
[*]Strafing on HTC Vive is changed so the strafe button just needs to be held instead of having to be pressed repeatedly to be able to move
[*]Default thumbstick deadzone value in the settings menu is set to 0.25. This results in a more consistent teleporting response
[*]A few other smaller fixes
[/list]

[h3]Attention![/h3]
If you already played Painting VR before this patch and you had some issues with the teleporting not always registering, you will have to tweak the thumbstick deadzone in the settings yourself! Here is how to do it:

[olist]
[*]Open the main menu
[*]Switch to the Settings tab (4th tab with the cogwheel icon)
[*]Scroll all the way down
[*]Set the "Thumbstick Deadzone" value to something like 0.25
[*]Done! Happy teleporting!
[/olist]
Here is an image of the menu you have to be looking for:

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41966877/3efcf5ee09a7acce69e5f71c539032a8077fc2dc.png[/img]
